title: Register Write
text: Write data to a register region on the specified IP core, 1 input, 1 output, {Output sink} sets Direct output to; {Simulink.Parameter object name} sets the name of Simulink.Parameter, {Register name} sets the name of a register in IP, {Device name} sets the path and file name of IP core device and {Offset address} sets the offset from the base address of the IP core to the register. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output sink
params.values: Direct output to port or base workspace To output port (default) | Base workspace | IP core register

params.name: Simulink.Parameter object name
params.values: Name of Simulink.Parameter object A (default) | character vector

params.name: Register name
params.values: Name of a register in IP Core RegA (default) | character vector

params.name: Device name
params.values: Path and file name of IP core device /dev/mwipcore (default) | character array

params.name: Offset address
params.values: Offset from the base address of the IP core to the register hex2dec(’0100’) (default) | positive integer
